plainEnglish.summary: Instructions and help do not depend on shape, colour, size, visual location, orientation or sound to make sense - 'the round button on the right' has to work for someone who cannot see it.
plainEnglish.whyItMatters: Directions given purely by appearance or position are unusable by screen reader users, and often by people with colour vision deficiencies or those using a reflowed, magnified layout.
